data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2010 experienced a prior year release of GBP 28.140 million, primarily driven by favorable claims development from earlier years of account (2001-2011) which closed into the 2012 year of account, and the 2012 year of account itself running off as expected. The 2012 year of account closed with a profit of GBP 81.1 million (inclusive of currency retranslation).
raw_causal_phrases: movements on the closed years of account (2001 to 2011) that occurred during the year
Prior closed years continue to run off satisfactorily both in the aggregate and individually, with all years but one contributing releases to the closing year result.

The losses that impacted the 2012 account, which were reported on in detail in the last two years Annual Reports, ran off as expected during 2014 and there were releases from the favourable run off of the earlier years of account that had closed into the 2012 account at 31 December 2013.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount is taken from the 'Gross claims incurred' for the '2012* account' column in the 'Results' table on page 13, which represents the contribution from prior years to the 2014 calendar year result. This is interpreted as a release given the overall positive run-off commentary. The percentage is calculated against the 2013 gross claims outstanding. The gross premium mix is derived from the 'Particulars of business written' table on page 34, which combines direct insurance and reinsurance acceptances. The 'Reinsurance acceptances' line is a consolidated total for all reinsurance business.
